Designed around your journey

Not every visitor needs the same conversation.

A support visitor needs a fast answer. A buyer needs confidence. A high-intent lead needs a clear route to your team.

A practical conversation model

  • Recognise the visitor’s goal
  • Ask only for useful context
  • Answer from approved information
  • Recommend the most relevant next step
  • Hand off when human judgement is needed
